description: A two-question AskUserQuestion dialog in Claude Code at 50 columns, its first tab (Beds) answered (☒) and its second (Shade) live under the tab strip. Claude draws the question as a quote block, every wrapped row led by a │ bar, so the prompt the model quotes only matches the screen if grounding skips the bar at each row's start. Before it did, the tab-2 question was rejected three times and the watcher kept showing tab 1's answered question and buttons. The tab strip is not a /config panel either (that rule needs a ▔▔▔ edge and an Esc to close footer). Fictional screen (tmux-rc, 2026-10-20).
